name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
purpose: Show the current location in a compact hierarchy while linking every applicable ancestor.
accessibility: Renders a labelled navigation landmark and ordered list.
The resolved current item exposes aria-current=page.
Separators are hidden from assistive technology.
commonMistakes: Making the current page an active link.
Using Breadcrumb as a substitute for primary navigation.
Adding visible separators to assistive-technology output.
